notes.title: 🌍 New Languages Support 🌍
notes.content:
🌍 New Languages Support! 🌍

We’re excited to announce that Queen's Garden : French Splendor now fully supports:

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321178/e36d57b8e7e68a492bfdb585b9251b41d1307d35.png[/img]
[*]French (français) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321178/fe58b225da5831df325aebc52cb8954701e88e05.png[/img]
[*]German (Deutsch)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321178/fe2f4b60ab7839b74d76ef2de176deef2e69ab2f.png[/img]
[*]Dutch (Nederlands)
[/list]

And that's not all! More languages are coming soon, so stay tuned for future updates.

Dive in and enjoy the game in your preferred language today! 🎉🌐
